description: This file defines the Microsoft Access driver for the ADOdb database abstraction library, including the class ADODB_access that extends ADODB_odbc, along with related classes and functions to support Access database interaction via ODBC on Windows.

classes.name: ADODB_access
classes.description: Implements the MS Access database driver using ODBC, with properties and methods to handle database-specific behavior and operations for Access.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_access
classes.description: Represents a record set returned when querying an Access database through this driver, extending the ODBC record set class.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Stub method for beginning a transaction, returns false as Access does not support transactions in this implementation.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Generates SQL to handle null values in fields, using Access SQL syntax.
